subject: Man arrested after boy, 3, injured in Cambridgeshire zoo crocodile enclosure
posts:

Evidence: Public safety, criminal investigation, tragic accident. #BreakingNews #UK

Authorities have arrested a 30-year-old man on suspicion of attempted murder following a distressing incident at a Cambridgeshire zoo.
